name: NZXT Hue 2
description: Per-LED lighting of NZXT's Hue 2 family, adapted from OpenRGB's NZXTHue2Controller: Hue 2 and Hue 2 Ambient, RGB & Fan Controllers, RGB Controllers, Smart Device V2, the Hue 2 / B650E motherboard controllers (ARGB channels of up to 40 LEDs each) and the Kraken X3 / Kraken 2024 Elite RGB coolers (Kraken X3: pump ring and logo plus the RGB header channel). Tested on hardware: Kraken X3 (1E71:2007, pump ring and logo); every other product is untested. Fan and pump speeds are never touched. Protocol notes: docs/hardware/nzxt-hue2.md.
